name: Tsunashima Erika
source:
Erika is an old friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c27887]his wife[/url]. In fact she has known them for so long that they think of her as their little sister. She has just returned from studying abroad. Erika was always a bit childish and pampered, but it seems that her trip abroad has helped her to grow up a bit. She's a very cheerful and happy girl. However, she's also hurting on the inside because of her unrequited feelings for Takashi. When she met [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url], who looks a lot like Takashi, she became more than a little interested in him.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.jastusa.com/target-pheromone.html]JAST USA[/url]]
